scientific_integrity: The theorem combines a mathematical exhaustiveness reduction with complete exact finite enumerations and a separate certificate checker; known graph-isomorphism-type totals are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Relative, not global, C2-equivalence in connected finite bipartite simple undirected graphs; exhaustive enumeration only through nine vertices. No general classification above nine or independent human audit is claimed. An unindexed prior small-order census remains possible.
title: The sharp nine-vertex colour-refinement threshold for connected bipartite graphs
